accounts_card_fields.name: accounts_card_fields
accounts_card_fields.value: "accounts"."kind" = 'bank' OR ("accounts"."credit_limit_paise" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."credit_limit_paise" > 0 AND "accounts"."statement_day" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."statement_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND "accounts"."due_day" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."due_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31)

txn_transfer_shape.name: txn_transfer_shape
txn_transfer_shape.value: ("transactions"."type" IN ('transfer', 'bill_payment') AND "transactions"."to_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."to_account_id" <> "transactions"."account_id" AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NULL) OR ("transactions"."type" NOT IN ('transfer', 'bill_payment') AND "transactions"."to_account_id" IS NULL)
